source_base: 3d-engine with presets/performance/autofocus and rover-wheel updates applied

build.dependencies: bundled Jolt 5.7.0 and SDL2, built from source

ctest.native_showcase_smoke: passed, 2 frames at t=40, GL and finite buffer validation

physics_cases: quadratic drag, including strong drag without velocity reversal
elastic unequal-mass collision momentum and energy
fixed tick backlog preservation and interpolation
thin wall swept blockers and ray normals
acceleration-limited motor arrival and blocker removal
kinematic release velocity and stale/nonfinite input rejection

showcase.inserted_wall: rover stops, six-wheel odometry stops; resumes without catch-up teleport
showcase.cargo: same body handle from mounted pickup to dynamic release, position continuous
showcase.mission_reset: removed cargo body and reset rover history

optics.cpu: FOV, CoC, EV100, ISO scaling, lumen/candela/lux, smooth spot-cone flux integration, Beer-Lambert, Fresnel, Snell and total internal reflection
optics.gpu: photometric falloff, physical exposure, aperture/defocused pixels, shutter/motion pixels, thin-lens DoF with GPU autofocus

compatibility.OpenGL_native_renderer: Mesa llvmpipe LLVM 19.1.7; software correctness testing, not GPU performance measurements
compatibility.installed_shared_static_consumers: both compiled and ran from exported SDK targets
compatibility.test_script_with_showcase: passed, source build/install and installed tests, GL 3.3 path, graphics-lab and showcase captures
compatibility.clean: removes new physics test outputs from external SDK and preserves source/unrelated files

limits: No native hardware GPU or Windows driver validation in this environment
Kinematic rotational sweep is conservative, not exact angular CCD
Current-world sweeps do not solve all future moving-body trajectories
Showcase wheel grounding is kinematic terrain fitting, not a suspension/drivetrain solver
Primitive colliders only; render meshes are not automatically collision shapes
RGB raster DoF and shutter blur are approximations; CPU refraction helpers do not add raster transmission/local shadow maps
